rules.v: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
rules.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
rules.n: Overseas Employment Promoters need a licence and a security deposit, which can be forfeited; the public Overseas Employment Corporation also recruits; no joint liability with the employer.

rules.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
rules.v: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
rules.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
rules.n: Service charges are capped by the Rules; charging more is an offense.

rules.v: A contract is required, but only for some categories of workers, or without minimum terms or verification
rules.vi: Kontrak wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori pekerja, atau tanpa syarat minimum atau verifikasi
rules.n: Registration with a Protector of Emigrants requires a work visa and an employment contract, but the law sets no minimum terms.

rules.v: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
rules.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
rules.n: Briefing at the Protectorate at registration is required; formal training is not compulsory.

rules.v: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
rules.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.n: Registration requires contributions to the Overseas Pakistanis Foundation and a compulsory insurance policy covering death and disability; the Foundation repatriates bodies and supports families.

rules.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.v: Officers are posted by administrative decision or policy, without a statutory duty
rules.vi: Atase ditempatkan berdasarkan keputusan administratif atau kebijakan, tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
rules.n: Community Welfare Attachés are posted by the Ministry; the Ordinance creates no such duty.

rules.v: Complaints lead to administrative sanctions or refunds of fees, but compensation needs the ordinary courts
rules.vi: Pengaduan menghasilkan sanksi administratif atau pengembalian biaya, tetapi ganti rugi memerlukan pengadilan umum
rules.n: Protectors of Emigrants and the Bureau act on complaints against promoters and forfeit deposits; offenses go to the Federal Investigation Agency and the courts.

rules.f: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
rules.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
rules.v: Restrictions whose terms apply to women only (higher minimum ages, consent requirements, bans)
rules.vi: Pembatasan yang secara tertulis hanya berlaku bagi perempuan (usia minimum lebih tinggi, syarat izin, larangan)
rules.n: The Rules set a minimum age for women going abroad as domestic workers: 35 until July 2025, now 25; the rule applies to women only.
rules.s: Emigration Rules 1979 r. 25 as amended 2025; ProPakistani, 30 Jul 2025

rules.v: Reintegration rests on policy or programs without a statutory duty
rules.vi: Reintegrasi bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
rules.n: The 2020 National Emigration and Welfare Policy commits to reintegration; no statutory duty was found.

rules.f: Shelter for workers in distress abroad
rules.fi: Tempat penampungan bagi pekerja bermasalah di luar negeri
rules.v: Shelters or safe houses are run at some missions by policy or practice
rules.vi: Tempat penampungan dikelola di sebagian perwakilan berdasarkan kebijakan atau praktik
rules.n: Community Welfare Attachés arrange shelter at some missions; no statutory duty found.

rules.v: An official line exists but not around the clock, or only at some missions
rules.vi: Saluran resmi ada tetapi tidak 24 jam, atau hanya di sebagian perwakilan
rules.n: The Overseas Pakistanis Foundation and the Ministry run helplines; round-the-clock operation is not confirmed.

rules.v: Legal assistance is funded by policy or discretionary funds
rules.vi: Bantuan hukum dibiayai berdasarkan kebijakan atau dana diskresioner
rules.n: Missions may fund legal assistance by policy.

rules.v: No gender-specific provision found
rules.vi: Tidak ditemukan ketentuan khusus gender
rules.n: No gender-specific provision on violence against women migrant workers found in the Ordinance or the 2020 Policy.

rules.fi: Kematian di luar negeri: pemulangan dan pemeriksaan
rules.v: Repatriation and a death benefit are provided, without a route to establish the cause of death
rules.vi: Pemulangan dan santunan kematian diberikan, tanpa jalur untuk memastikan sebab kematian
rules.n: The Overseas Pakistanis Foundation repatriates remains free of charge and insurance pays a death benefit; no independent examination route found.

rules.fi: UU antiperdagangan orang yang mencakup kerja
rules.v: A dedicated statute criminalizes trafficking for forced labor and provides victim assistance, protection or restitution
rules.vi: UU khusus memidanakan perdagangan orang untuk kerja paksa dan menyediakan bantuan, pelindungan atau restitusi bagi korban
rules.n: Dedicated Act criminalizes trafficking in persons including for forced labor, with victim protection.
rules.s: Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act 2018

rules.v: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
rules.vi: Hukum ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku, atau undang-undang khusus memberi hak-hak intinya
rules.n: Provincial statute granting core labor rights (Punjab as reference; Islamabad Act 2022 similar).

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required, no language rule
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib, tanpa aturan bahasa
rules.n: Letter of appointment.

rules.v: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
rules.vi: Upah minimum menurut undang-undang berlaku sama dengan pekerja lain
rules.n: Minimum wage notified for domestic workers.

rules.v: Periodic payment required, without further safeguards
rules.vi: Pembayaran berkala wajib, tanpa pengaman lain
rules.n: Monthly payment.

rules.v: Normal hours limited as for other workers
rules.vi: Jam kerja normal dibatasi seperti pekerja lain
rules.n: 8 hours a day.

rules.v: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
rules.vi: Minimal 24 jam berturut-turut, tidak dapat diganti uang atas permintaan pemberi kerja
rules.n: One day of weekly rest.

rules.v: Shorter than for other workers
rules.vi: Lebih pendek dari pekerja lain
rules.n: Casual, sick and festival leave.

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: No rule
rules.vi: Tidak ada aturan
rules.n: No rule.

rules.v: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
rules.vi: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan
rules.n: Decent accommodation for live-in workers.
Not determined.
Not determined.
Not determined.

rules.v: Complaint-based or agency inspection only
rules.vi: Hanya berdasarkan pengaduan atau pengawasan agen
rules.n: Inspectors under the Act.

rules.v: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
rules.vi: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya
rules.n: Domestic Workers Dispute Resolution Committees.

rules.v: Included in the general social security system, including maternity
rules.vi: Termasuk dalam sistem jaminan sosial umum, termasuk kehamilan
rules.n: Social security registration.

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.v: Specific provisions with a remedy
rules.vi: Ketentuan khusus dengan pemulihan
rules.n: Protection from harassment; child domestic work below 15 prohibited.

rules.v: May form and join trade unions
rules.vi: Boleh membentuk dan bergabung dengan serikat
rules.n: May form and join unions.

laws.tp: Registration, fees, insurance, minimum age for women in domestic work

Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act 2018

decisions.nm: Darshan Masih v. The State (brick kiln workers)
decisions.pe: Families working in brick kilns in Pakistan were trapped by debts they could never repay. The Supreme Court said this was unconstitutional and ordered protection. A law banning bonded labour followed in 1992.
decisions.pi: Keluarga yang bekerja di tempat pembakaran batu bata di Pakistan terjerat utang yang tak mungkin dilunasi. MA menyatakan ini inkonstitusional dan memerintahkan perlindungan. UU yang melarang kerja ijon menyusul pada 1992.

decisions.pe: An Indian man was sentenced to death by a military court in Pakistan without his consulate being allowed to see him. The International Court of Justice said Pakistan must review the case.
decisions.pi: Seorang pria India dihukum mati oleh pengadilan militer di Pakistan tanpa konsulatnya diizinkan menemuinya. Mahkamah Internasional menyatakan Pakistan harus meninjau perkara itu.

help.de: Free legal help for Pakistanis held in prisons abroad, many of them migrant workers in the Gulf, and for their families.
help.di: Bantuan hukum gratis bagi warga Pakistan yang ditahan di penjara luar negeri, banyak di antaranya pekerja migran di Teluk, dan bagi keluarganya.
